---
description: Review selected code and suggest useful, safe logging statements without changing files.
---

Use the `logging-advisor` skill. Analyze the selected code, current file, or named methods. Detect the project's actual logging framework and conventions. Suggest only high-value logging points and provide file/method, level, example statement, reason, and data-safety notes. Do not log secrets or unnecessarily large payloads. Do not modify code; provide recommendations only.
